image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) curled up on a gray stone surface. The salamander displays the characteristic black and yellow warning coloration with irregular yellow spots and bands on a glossy black body. The body is robust and cylindrical, with short limbs visible. The head is broad and flattened, and the tail is laterally compressed and shorter than the body length.
